about:
American Plastic Manufacturing, doing business as American Plastic Mfg., Inc., operates from a facility on South Monroe Street in Seattle, Washington. The company's founding date and ownership details—such as whether it is family‑owned, veteran‑owned, or woman‑owned—are not disclosed in public sources.

The company's core business is the manufacture of custom printed plastic bags. No information is available about the specific production processes (e.g., extrusion, flexographic printing, converting), the size of the plant, employee count, annual volume, or the breadth of its product catalog.

American Plastic distributes its bags solely through a network of bag distributors; it does not engage in direct sales to end users. The industries ultimately served by those distributors—such as food packaging, industrial packaging, or retail—are not specified in the available material.

The firm has not articulated a founding mission or a stated competitive advantage beyond its distributor‑only channel strategy. No certifications, quality standards, or export compliance registrations are mentioned.
